## ENDPOINT & MODEL SWAP HERE

Edit the **Endpoint Config** node directly in this workflow to switch between any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint:

- **Local OpenAI-compatible bridge / server (default)**:
  - `base_url`: `http://host.docker.internal:8787/v1`
  - `model` & `api_key`: configured in **Endpoint Config**
- **Ollama (OpenAI-compatible API)**:
  - `base_url`: `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1`
  - `model`: `gemma4:12b-mlx`
  - `api_key`: `ollama`
- **Official OpenAI**:
  - `base_url`: `https://api.openai.com/v1`
  - `model`: `gpt-5.5` (or `gpt-4.1`)
  - `api_key`: `sk-...`
